title: SAST Policy Compiler
description: Compiles static analysis security testing (SAST) configuration. Enforces: OWASP Top 10 categories covered, error severity findings block the build, all suppressions have expiry dates, and all project languages are included in scans.

error_codes.ST001: sast-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: tool, languages[], rules[], blockOnSeverity
error_codes.ST002: SAST rule set does not cover all OWASP Top 10 categories — missing: injection, broken-auth, xss, etc.
error_codes.ST003: Error-severity SAST findings do not block the build — set blockOnSeverity to 'error' or 'high'
error_codes.ST004: SAST suppression has no expiry date — all suppressions must expire within 90 days
error_codes.ST005: Not all programming languages in the project are covered by the SAST scan configuration
